note: Athletics hosts verified individually, not by batch. Each row records BOTH anchors that established it: an official institution page that links to the host, and the host's own self-identification. The shape follows the three OFFICIAL_DIRECTORY_AND_PAGE_SELF_IDENTIFICATION rows already in the ledger (cokercobras.com, bsubears.com, fsurams.com), including their treatment of an abbreviated og:site_name as WHOLE_NAME identity: the strength column records that the identity is whole rather than a short-base-name coincidence, and the notes column carries the audit trail.

https://www.saintmarys.edu/athletics (the institution's own domain, whose page names Notre Dame, IN as the registry does) redirects to belles.saintmarys.edu, which self-identifies as "Saint Mary's College" and whose store link reads schools/indiana/notredame/saint-marys-college. L7B measured seven of the eight BASE_ONLY rows as wrong and this as the one correct member, which left it quarantined for discovery on a rule it did not deserve. Repaired on the same standard as the rest of this seed rather than by loosening the rule: https://www.regis.edu/ self-identifies as "Regis University | Jesuit Catholic University in Denver, Colorado" — Denver, CO as the registry has it, which separates it from Regis College in Massachusetts — and links 'Athletics' to regisrangers.com, whose own OG_SITE_NAME reads "Regis University Athletics".
